title: Separate sparse checkpoint residency from dense prefix coverage
applies_when: Designing cache events, routing or offload lookup for hybrid attention/recurrent models whose state snapshots exist only at selected token boundaries.
lesson: Trace the exact checkpoint key through registration, lookup and slot reuse before changing a placeholder event into a self-describing prefix. A recurrent state at boundary N need not permit resuming at any smaller boundary. Group classification identifies the kind of cache, not which checkpoints are resident. Test an earlier-prefix miss, an exact-boundary hit, fallback to a separately retained earlier checkpoint, and removal after overwriting a state slot. Distinguish wire hash interval, valid token extent, physical page geometry and transfer chunk size; they need not be equal. In the cited vLLM partial-entry path, a 16-token Mamba page with a 4-token hash interval emits one checkpoint hash and block_size=4. The parent hash is a chain reference, not proof that another Mamba state is resident there. Reuse full-attention metadata only after verifying these consumer semantics; do not advertise every intermediate hash as a recurrent resume point.
avoid_when: A dense checkpoint policy or a consumer that explicitly reconstructs missing states can support different coverage. The cited component test registers entries directly: it does not establish scheduler production of those entries, CPU offload transfer, router integration, whole-model accuracy, saved bytes or performance. A live local cache event and an offload-tier event can have different lifecycle/ownership contracts. Inspect consumer ingress and conversion before treating richer producer events as an end-to-end repair: the cited Dynamo device/host path filters non-main-attention groups, and conversion discards group/type/ownership fields. Its lower-tier bypass has different semantics; removing that filter alone is not group-aware indexing. Do not remove an intentional unsupported-shape guard solely to make richer events appear, duplicate an existing classification PR, or infer all-prefix reuse from a page-size or hash-chain match.

evidence.note: Mamba lookup searches candidate checkpoint hashes from right to left, inserts null earlier state positions and returns the boundary of an actually resident state. A later state does not synthesize earlier checkpoints.

Partial-entry registration uses the prefix-chain hash at the exact boundary, removes prior slot keys when replacing contents, and emits a single boundary hash with the final hash interval's tokens and size. Parent-chain and state-residency semantics are distinct.

Device/HostPinned events pass through metadata filtering; Disk/External bypass it. filter_reason at lines356-388 rejects known non-main-attention kinds/groups. These source facts persist byte-for-byte from the reported ea23e513 revision; no native Rust/router run or complete fix is established.

The store conversion pattern ignores group_idx, kv_cache_spec_kind, sliding-window metadata and ownership before building a placement event. A producer-only payload change cannot by itself establish per-group checkpoint-aware matching in this consumer.

Independent AI-assisted native CPU component check: six cases passed on pinned core sources in a reused package, covering absent earlier checkpoints, exact/fallback hits, event extent and overwritten-slot invalidation. CUDA remained hidden/uninitialized; no full conftest, serving, router, offload-transfer or performance qualification.
